test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Anuj, Bala, Charanjit, Danish, Endrew, Farooq, Garvit, and Himesh are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Four of them are sitting at each of the corners, while the other four are sitting at the exact centre of each of the sides.

<span style="font-family: var(--bs-body-font-family); font-size: var(--bs-body-font-size); font-weight: var(--bs-body-font-weight); text-align: var(
solution:
Given: Anuj, Bala, Charanjit, Danish, Endrew, Farooq, Garvit, and Himesh.

1) Endrew who sits middle of a side, sits to the fourth left of the Garvit.

2) Charanjit sits to the third right of Endrew.

3) Himesh sits to the immediate left of Charanjit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30a540d7d0b845f2e9779e777f3ae114108dcbd59bd9bbb184ad8ed181e7bbc3.png] 

4) Only one person sits between Garvit and Farooq.

5) Bala is not a neighbour of Farooq.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10066b56609cf6b369b733d50a6672b422580cfb86455f852f4329e32eb80ed5.png] 

6) Bala is immediate neighbour of Endrew and Only three people sit between Bala and Anuj.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c9b77098ab480d10084b834d66073ab4af06bce3b264c45a4aa66358905d6ca.png] 

∴ Here, 'Himesh' sits third to the right of Danish

Hence, the correct answer is** "Himesh".**
